gloss: hair root; root of a hair

definitions.gloss: hair root; root of a hair
definitions.explanation: the part of a hair that is embedded in the skin, anchored within the hair follicle

examples.japanese: {毛根|もうこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかりして→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}け→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧にくい。
examples.english: If the hair roots are strong, hair is less likely to fall out.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毛根|もうこん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: This shampoo nourishes the hair roots.

examples.japanese: {毛根|もうこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{死|し}んで→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧しまう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧こない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that once the hair roots die, hair will never grow back from that spot.

notes:
Composed of {毛|もう} (hair; fur) + {根|こん} (root). Commonly discussed in the context of hair care, hair loss prevention, and dermatology. Hair care advertisements in Japan frequently reference {毛根|もうこん} health.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毛根|もうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to strengthen hair roots
- {毛根|もうこん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to nourish the hair roots
- {毛根|もうこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}る→弱る：02439_yowaru⟧: hair roots weaken
- {毛根|もうこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧: hair roots die

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毛穴|けあな}→毛穴：16138_keana⟧: pore — the opening in the skin from which hair grows
- ⟦{毛髪|もうはつ}→毛髪：16588_mouhatsu⟧: hair (formal/medical) — the hair itself rather than its root
- {頭皮|とうひ}: scalp — the skin on the head where hair roots are embedded
